Metadata.title: Tourneasy — badminton tournaments in the Netherlands
Metadata.description: Find badminton tournaments, enter online, pay with iDEAL and follow matches and results live.

Home.heroText: Find a tournament, enter singles, doubles or mixed, pay with iDEAL and follow your matches live.
Home.featureFollowText: Get notified when your club mates and favourites play.
Home.aboutTitle: Built for players, clubs and organisers
Home.aboutText: One platform for the whole tournament day, from entry to final. Organisers plan draws and courts, players follow every result live.
Home.featureLiveText: Results reach every phone the moment they are entered.
Home.featurePayText: Pay your entry fee securely; refunds take one click.
Home.featureScheduleText: Match schedules and court plans are proposed for you and can be adjusted by hand.

Legal.draftNotice: Draft — this text is still being reviewed legally.
Legal.privacyBody: Tourneasy processes your data to make tournament entries, payments and results possible. We only process what is needed: name, contact details, date of birth (for age categories), gender (for events), club and playing level. Data is stored within the EU. You can download your data or delete your account at any time via My account → Privacy. For players under 16 we ask permission from a parent or guardian and show no data publicly. Questions? Contact the organisation.
Legal.termsBody: By creating an account you agree to use Tourneasy to enter and follow badminton tournaments. Entries are final after payment. Withdrawals and refunds follow the policy of the tournament concerned. Organisers are responsible for their tournaments. Misuse of the platform may lead to your account being blocked.
